name: Filter Strength Music Reveal
use_when: A look, filter, or mood shift should arrive with the music after a speech section.
A montage, B-roll, or reveal needs a visible energy lift without hard-cutting to a different grade.
The edit wants the audio rise and color treatment to feel like one intentional transition.
avoid_when: The filter has no story, mood, or energy job.
The filter makes faces, captions, proof, UI, product detail, or brand color harder to read.
The music should stay low because speech, testimony, or narration continues.
A cut to a corrected or graded shot would communicate the change more cleanly.

timeline_pattern.sync_rule: Align the filter-strength rise with the music returning after the phrase clears.
timeline_pattern.speech_rule: Do not raise filter intensity or music while the viewer still needs to parse the spoken line.
timeline_pattern.hold_rule: After the reveal, hold the full look only while the montage or mood beat benefits from it.

motion.rule: Do not add extra zoom, shake, or blur during the filter reveal unless the same beat needs motion emphasis.

sound.rule: Music can rise with the filter strength only after dialogue clears.

keyframe_values.ducked_speech: Keep the bed low under speech, often around -15 dB to -20 dB as a starting range depending on the track.
keyframe_values.restore: Return music toward full level or 0 dB over a few frames after the phrase ends.
keyframe_values.sync: Use the same start/end frames for music restore and filter-strength rise when the reveal should feel unified.

captions.rule: Caption contrast must hold at both filter strength 0 and full strength.

color.rule: Keyframe the filter's strength, opacity, or amount rather than stacking multiple uncontrolled filters.

keyframe_values.capcut_strength_start: 0 strength at the start of the reveal.
keyframe_values.capcut_strength_end: 100 strength or the approved final look amount at the reveal landing frame.
keyframe_values.safe_variant: Use a lower final strength when full intensity harms skin, proof, product, or caption readability.

implementation.ffmpeg: Interpolate color/filter parameters or crossfade between neutral and treated versions while applying a matching audio gain envelope.
implementation.remotion: Drive CSS/filter, LUT amount, or color token strength from the same frame range as the music gain interpolation.
implementation.blender: Keyframe compositor filter mix factor or adjustment-node value while keyframing audio volume in the VSE.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Place the filter or adjustment above the target range, add a Strength keyframe at 0, move to the music-rise landing frame, raise Strength toward 100, and align music volume keyframes to the same reveal.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Use an adjustment layer with keyframed Lumetri/effect amount or opacity while clip-volume keyframes restore the music after dialogue.

common_mistakes: Raising music and filter strength before the spoken phrase has finished.
Using a strong filter to manufacture energy when the section still lacks a clear visual or story beat.
Letting the filter crush captions, skin, proof, UI, or product colors.
Leaving the full filter active after the montage or mood beat ends.
Keyframing several color controls independently when a single strength/amount control would be easier to QC.
qc: Does the filter rise align with the music restore frame or intentionally offset from it?
Does dialogue remain intelligible before the reveal?
Do captions, faces, proof, UI, products, and brand colors remain readable at full filter strength?
Does the full look hold only as long as the montage or mood beat needs it?
Is the music licensed, platform-safe, or marked temp-only?
